name: How quickly can emergency storm damage repairs begin?

mainEntity.name: How quickly can emergency storm damage repairs begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Emergency response times vary depending on the severity of the weather event and widespread regional impact. In typical situations, contractors can conduct a site assessment and begin emergency mitigation—such as cutting out falling drywall and bracing structural framing—within 24 to 48 hours of initial contact. Full reconstruction takes longer because framing, subfloors, and wall cavities must completely dry to normal moisture levels before hanging new drywall or installing flooring. Working with an owner-operated contractor like Abraham Becerra provides direct communication on exact scheduling from initial teardown through final finish work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial mitigation and safety stabilization typically start within 24 to 48 hours, while full reconstruction begins after framing and subfloors dry thoroughly.
